note: The first frozen holdout for the release incident, the second incident definition. It uses the same investigator, policy, and executor as the onboarding holdouts; nothing was changed for this suite. The six cases were written after four development trials on the plain release sample and the sample with replies (4/4), are all different from those two, and were frozen with the implementation before any model call on them.

cases.title: A person moved the release issue to Blocked
cases.rationale: The repeat is identical and has no replies, so it can be removed. A person changed the issue after the agent, so their Blocked state is kept, and the correction reports it.

cases.title: The repeated post was edited to add rollback steps
cases.repeatMessage: Release v2.4 is live in production. Rollback steps for on-call are in this thread.
cases.rationale: The repeated post now carries information the original does not, so removing it would lose work. The agent's stale state change is still restored and corrected.

cases.title: Someone already removed the repeat, reset the issue, and corrected the thread
cases.correction: Correction: v2.4 is not live yet because the release check is still running. The duplicate post was deleted and REL-42 is back In Review.
cases.rationale: People already repaired everything, and the existing correction accurately describes the outcome. Nothing should be written or posted again.

cases.title: The journal lost the release issue's previous state
cases.rationale: Without the state before the agent's change there is nothing verified to restore, so the investigator must escalate without writing.

cases.title: An existing correction wrongly says the release is verified
cases.correction: Correction: REL-44 is done and v2.4 is verified live; the repeated post was intentional.
cases.rationale: The posted correction contradicts the evidence: the release check had not passed and the post was a lost-response repeat. A second correction is not allowed and keeping a false one is wrong, so the investigator must escalate.

cases.title: People replied to the repeat and a person moved the issue to Blocked
cases.rationale: A reply attaches human work to the repeat, and a person changed the issue state, so both are kept. Only the correction is written.
